subject: Fees outstanding — learner {{student_id}}
body:
Dear {{recipient_name}},

Our records show {{amount_due}} outstanding on {{first_name}}'s account for {{course_title}}, due {{due_date}}.

If you have paid in the last few days, thank you — please ignore this.

If paying in full is difficult, contact the finance team on {{college_phone}}. We can usually arrange instalments, and there is a bursary fund for learners who qualify. Nobody is removed from a course for asking about this.

Finance Team
{{college_name}}
